evidence.detail: The class owns exactly two rs/s/q/a/b participant records plus one aggregate integer. Construction initializes both participant names to exact sentinel 'N/A'.
R12 PvPTrackerPlugin rs/s/q/d owns one current rs/s/q/a/a in field k and an ArrayList<rs/s/q/a/a> fight history in field l; public accessors expose the current fight and history separately.

When the current fight is complete, PvPTrackerPlugin creates a new rs/s/q/a/a, deep-copies both participant records and the fight aggregate into it, appends that snapshot to fight history, sends it to PvPTrackerPanel, then replaces current state with a fresh rs/s/q/a/a.
The model compares the two participants' paired percentage metrics and exposes both participant records, matching the reviewed PvP Tracker 'Current Fight' and fight-history presentation.

candidates.note: PvPTrackerFight is fixed by exact PvPTrackerPlugin ownership: one current two-participant model is deep-copied into fight history and then reset. Confidence is 0.999.

evidence.detail: Each rs/s/q/a/b stores one fighter name, five integer counters/aggregate values and one boolean state. PvPTrackerFight owns exactly two of these records.
The class maintains two current/total counter pairs, computes two clamped float ratios, formats each pair as current/total/(percentage), and exposes all underlying values through accessors.
R141 PvPTrackerPacketHandler writes fighter names, paired counters/ratios, aggregate values and death state into these exact records through the R12 PvPTrackerPlugin current-fight model.

PvPTrackerPlugin history finalization clones each fighter's name, aggregate, both paired counter sets and boolean death state into new rs/s/q/a/b records before archiving the completed PvPTrackerFight.

candidates.note: PvPTrackerFighterStats is descriptive exact-behavior recovery for each participant's name/counter/ratio/death record inside current and archived PvP Tracker fights. Confidence is 0.999.
